constraints_found.constraint: Craving: Thai food (Liam, backed by Maya)
source_lines: liam: ok so i dreamed about thai food last night. a whole table of it. woke up starving. i need thai
maya: i would fight someone for thai right now. i'm in

constraints_found.constraint: Allergy (deal-breaker): Cyrus is allergic to peanuts
source_lines: liam: wait. thai. cyrus. are we okay after the satay incident??
brooke: i'll still double check for you. no satay, no dipping sauce, nothing crushed on top of the noodles. same as always

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: cheapest tier ($), saving for the coast trip
source_lines: maya: tight. if lunch costs more than a few bucks, the trip fund cries. and then i cry
liam: cheap thai is the best thai anyway

constraints_found.constraint: Preference: light, not fried or greasy (Brooke is climbing after work)
source_lines: brooke: count me in! climbing after work though, and the last time i had a fried lunch i didn't make it past the first hold

venue_reasoning.downtown_orchid_row: Thai, $, a reviewer with a peanut allergy has eaten there every week (sauces included) with no reaction, and the food is steamed and light. Meets every constraint.
venue_reasoning.downtown_monsoon_alley: Thai, $, light, but peanut satay dip and crushed peanuts on the noodles. Deal-breaker for Cyrus.
venue_reasoning.downtown_teak_door: Thai, $, peanut-safe, but almost everything is fried or oily. Misses Brooke's preference: 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.downtown_river_bell: Thai, peanut-free, light, but $$, one tier over budget: 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.downtown_koi_counter: Sushi, $, light, peanut-safe, but not Thai. Misses the craving: 2 stars.

notes: Fair and solvable. The peanut allergy is never named outright. You have to infer it from the 'satay incident' and Brooke's list (satay, dipping sauce, crushed toppings), which is a good indirect clue for a returning player. A new player might take a moment longer. 'More than a few bucks' clearly points to $. Brooke's fried-lunch line is clear. Each decoy fails exactly one constraint, so the puzzle is clean. Small note: Orchid Row's review says 'curries and dipping sauces included' are safe, which directly answers Brooke's dipping-sauce worry. That is good design, not too obvious. Nothing contradictory found.
